name: The Prince
source:
Your twin brother, the favoured child of your wealthy media magnate father, attends a much nicer high school than you do. Can you really pretend to be a man you hardly even know anymore...?
Pursuable?: UGH, GROSS

[From the [url=http://ladykillerinabind.com/]Official Website[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Laurence Smith, Jr.[/spoiler]
